feature_contract.goal: Carry actual 10-bit native DX11 menu/vehicle/race game stereo through the production R23 DirectGPU eye copy, nonblocking pixel inspection and OpenXR projection while rejecting same-allocation or mixed-format eye frames without replacing original D3D9 controls.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The production x64 R23 host admits independent nonzero stereo handles and rejects an identical source pair before considering native-game OpenXR bootstrap.
Actual held left/right GPU copies require distinct canonical IUnknown allocations, even if two texture interface pointers differ.
Native R10G10B10A2 packed GPU sources decode RGB channel bits correctly while null buffers and mixed-format eye pairs remain denied; original D3D9 Draw/input/FFB and SBS fallback remain untouched.
The existing compiled WARP native direct-eye smoke and all required exact-SHA GitHub Gates succeed without enabling native gameplay by default.

integration_path: Live game-created D3D9->native D3D11 full-size left and right GPU resources admitted through exact shared-handle bootstrap
Production R23 host imports and canonical-identity checks separate left/right GPU resources before CopyResource into OpenXR-owned hold
Nonblocking RGB10 source pixel inspection decodes real source format; direct R23 projection uses existing 2-eye transport or original SBS fallback
batch_components: Production x64 R23 DirectGPU bootstrap, identity and hold texture CopyResource C++ code
Shared GPU-eye 10-bit pixel decode and supported source format C++ implementation
Compiled Windows WARP native DirectGPU eye smoke positive and negative cases

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Compiled WARP smoke: separate GPU textures and correctly decoded red/green/blue packed RGB10 source pixels; 10-bit pair admitted.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Alias/missing GPU eyes, equal handles, mixed 10/8-bit formats, missing pixel buffers rejected; native projection never enabled by this commit.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Native D3D11 game eye -> R23 DirectGPU source import and canonical pair validation -> host hold CopyResource -> RGB10 source pixel inspection -> OpenXR stereo route; DX9Ex input/FFB remains authoritative.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Source/Windows CI only; matching Quest3/VDXR game/menu/race images untested.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: NativeDrawPathActive remains default-off; original D3D9 Draw/Present/gamepad/FFB/SkyGlow/DX9Ex fallback preserved; DXVK untouched.
